title: Kestrel and the Landfall
author: G. M. Brightwater
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
